title: TROVE: a flow-labelled hardware-Trojan benchmark
description:
TROVE is a hardware-Trojan benchmark whose labels are defined per synthesis flow. Each sample is a Trojan inserted into an ISCAS-89 or ITC'99 host circuit, and each (sample, flow) pair carries a label record stating whether the Trojan is functional, inert or removed after synthesis, with the equivalence proof and the witness that support the label.

This version (1.1-draft) holds 1,748 samples (874 live twins and 874 decoys) on 46 hosts and three open-source synthesis flows, 5,244 label records in total. The 27 ISCAS-89 hosts come with netlists and RTL. The 19 ITC'99 hosts come with labels, netlist hashes and witnesses only, because ITC'99 is licensed under EUPL-1.2.

The benchmark data is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (file LICENSE-DATA); host circuits keep their upstream terms, which that file lists. The code in the repository is licensed under MIT (file LICENSE). Start with release/README.md.
